systems.country_label: Système national d'identité numérique (SNID); numéro d'identification unique (NUI)
systems.tiers: announced 28 November 2025 at USD 13 million; implementation window 2027 to 2032, procurement and assessments still ahead; meant to unify and secure the existing biometric and civil registration databases

note: An announced national digital identity system, not yet deployed; civil registration appears only as data the identity system is to unify, with nothing on how offices register events.
